activity_summary: At night the two plays were over without you. The sentence is still unsent. You did not write the packet, and you did not set anything beside the horn for Sunday.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the packet and refused to set Sunday's gift out early.

facets.activity: Did not write the packet or set anything beside the horn

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Not the packet. The packet is not this;
